open_points.subject: revision sent by the owner interface for already erased or anonymised records
open_points.text: Rule 3 says, “An anonymised project and an erased Customer have no revision: an action on them states none,” but the Consequence says, “the owner interface always shows and sends the revision of the card it rendered.”
open_points.question: For an action on an anonymised Project or erased Customer, must the owner interface send no revision as rule 3 requires, or must it somehow send a revision as the Consequence requires?
options: Send no revision for records that have none
Require or synthesize a revision even though the record has none
Do not offer such actions in the owner interface
open_points.default_guess: Treat rule 3 as a specific exception and send no revision.

witness.initial: An anonymised Project exists with no revision.
events: The owner opens its erased-project view.
The owner submits the action to anonymise it again.
outcomes: The interface sends no revision; A04 rule 3 and A05 accept the action unchanged.
The interface must send a revision, but none can be shown from the record, so the form cannot be submitted conformingly or is refused.

open_points.subject: repeated transition carrying the pre-erasure revision
open_points.text: A05's formal invariant says, “transition t to state s on record r with state(r) = s: accepted, r unchanged,” while changed A04 says that when the record has no revision and a revision is stated, the action is “refused as stale”; its required tests apply this to repeated Customer erasure.
open_points.question: Is A05's formal invariant conditional on passing A04's revision check, so that a repeated transition carrying the old revision is refused, or is every transition to the current state accepted regardless of that stale revision?
options: Refuse the repeated transition as stale when it states the old revision
Accept every same-state transition unchanged as A05's formal invariant states
open_points.default_guess: Apply A04's revision check first and refuse the old-revision submission as stale.

witness.initial: A Customer was at revision 4 and has just had its contact data erased; it is now erased and has no revision.
events: The owner resubmits the original erase form, which still states revision 4.
outcomes: A04 refuses the submission as stale.
A05's unconditional formal invariant accepts the same-state erasure and returns the Customer unchanged.

open_points.subject: security review status after the A04 change
open_points.text: A21 rule 2 says, “A change to a decision a category names reopens this review.” Its concurrency category names A04, but A21 still says “Security review: PERFORMED,” that the review is complete, and that every named decision is accepted.
open_points.question: After the stated change to A04, has the concurrency security review been performed again and accepted, or is A21 reopened and not yet closed?
options: A21 is reopened pending a new review of the changed A04 behavior
The changed A04 behavior has been reviewed and A21 remains performed and accepted
open_points.default_guess: Mark A21 reopened until the concurrency category is reviewed again.
